fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-Criminal Record Report * 2. Financial Guarantee You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. TOEFL, IELTS or other English level certificate * 4. Passport If your passport expires before December 2026, you must apply for a new one before submission. * 5. 6 photos (size: 3.5*4.9cm) * 6. High School Transcript Transcript in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 7. High School Certificate The certificate in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 8. Foreigner Physical Examination Form The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form, which is designed by the Chinese quarantine authority (The form shall be filled in English. Its original copy shall be kept by the applicants.) Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens in good health both mentally and physically with a high school graduation certificate or equivalent. 2. Applicants for English-taught programs must submit a copy of official IELTS report (6.0 or above), TOFEL report (over 80) or other English proficiency certificates. 3. China Scholastic Competency Assessment Transcript This assessment is organized by the China Scholarship Counicl on behalf of the Ministry of Education of People’s Republic of China. All applicants must take the assessment in advance and get the score report. The assessment contents includes professional Chinese, mathematics, physics and chemistry. Fundamental subjects All applicants must take mathematics test. According to different majors, applicants must participate in physics and chemistry tests after confirming with Northeast Forestry University. Language used for testing Assessments for mathematics, physics, and chemistry are available in both Chinese and English. Applicants can choose the language of the test paper based on the teaching language.
